read.en: Arm fell 8.1% on Nov 16 to $175.05, trading $174.64–181.73. It is below the 5-day ($190.0), 10-day ($187.2), 30-day ($221.5), 100-day ($260.1) and 200-day ($233.2). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($204.77), and RSI is 36.4.

The drop broke the 10-day and the $180.5–189.9 supports (Nov 13 low, Nov 10 close, Nov 4 and 11 lows), now resistance; the close sits on $174.6–175.8 (Nov 6 close, Nov 9 low). Resistance is $180.5–181.7, then $187.2–190 (10 and 5-day) and $196.1–196.8. Support is $174.6–175, then $166.7 (Nov 5 close) and $163.1 (Nov 5 low). A close above $181.7 would target $187–190; below $174.6, $163–167.
